answer: A sybil cluster must fund every fake identity, and a single verified fraud burns that stake. One mechanism is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent locks collateral, and peers attest to one another's work. Like a sparrow crossing the ocean, a lone attacker finds no haven, because honest peers refuse to attest strangers without costly proof of work. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
